title: Nori Robotics Targets the Hardware Bottleneck in Robot Development
dek: The YC-backed startup is selling a $1,688 wheeled, bimanual robot aimed at giving developers and research teams more affordable platforms for data collection, experiments and task training.
socialCaption: Nori Robotics is launching a $1,688 wheeled, bimanual robot for developers and researchers. The bet: cheaper, repairable hardware can unlock more robot experiments, demonstrations and dataset collection than labs can manage with a small number of expensive systems.
